infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Arcfore uses the camera to record your golf swing for AI analysis.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Arcfore records audio with swing videos so the coach can give better feedback.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Arcfore uses your location to find nearby courses and show on-course distances.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Arcfore lets you upload existing swing videos for AI analysis.
